articles.title: Standard Chartered sees more pain after $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

articles.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
articles.snippet: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

articles.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
articles.snippet: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.
